tool_input.description: Manually exercise rotate/verify flags after refactor

result:
Leaving the scratch file in `/tmp` (removing it would need extra approval; it's harmless).

Done — all 9 tests pass (`all tests passed`).

**What changed and why:**
- `rotate.sh`: the surplus set was `tail -n +KEEP` on an oldest-first list, which selected the newest entries and fired even at exactly N archives. Now the early exit is `total <= keep` ("nothing to rotate") and surplus is `head -n (total-keep)` — the oldest entries beyond the newest N (rotate.sh:79-86).
- `verify.sh`: `awk '{print $2}'` truncated a sidecar name at the first space, so `my backup-…tar.gz` became `my` → "archive missing" → BAD. Now `read -r expected file` splits off only the digest and keeps the rest of the name (verify.sh:87-92); the digest comparison is also quoted.
- `lib/common.sh` (new): holds the shared option parser as `parse_common_options` plus `is_uint`, `need_value` and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it and call it after defining their `usage`/`parse_local_option`, keeping all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `-q`, `-n`, `-h`, `--`, and `--flag=value` forms) working. `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` untouched.
- `tests/run_tests.sh`: added a verify test for a space in the archive name and a rotate group covering "exactly KEEP archives deletes nothing" and "keep 2 removes the oldest, not the newest".

Changed files: `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `lib/common.sh` (new), `tests/run_tests.sh`.
